headline: Amazon Airplane Overshoots Runway, 5 Die (DJ Akademiks Claims)
body: DJ Akademiks reported on Instagram that 5 people died when an Amazon airline plane overshot the runway. The post, published September 6, 2026, claims the incident occurred but lacks official confirmation. The post has garnered 1,746 likes and 296 comments. This is a serious claim that requires verification as Amazon does not operate commercial airlines.

caption:
This post by DJ Akademiks claims an Amazon airline plane overshot the runway, killing 5 people. The post is dated September 6, 2026. Amazon does not operate commercial airlines, so this incident is likely fictional or misreported. The post has been shared widely but lacks official confirmation from authorities or Amazon.
